purpose: Educational review criteria; not bank policy or production approval

rules.label: ROC-AUC
rules.follow_up: Review ranking errors and assess a genuinely new validation cohort.

rules.label: Brier score
rules.follow_up: Investigate probability errors, prevalence and calibration; do not tune on this inspected test.

rules.label: Log loss
rules.follow_up: Inspect confidently wrong predictions using independently governed development data.

rules.label: Calibration slope
rules.follow_up: Review calibration uncertainty and obtain a new cohort before considering refitting.

rules.label: Joint calibration intercept
rules.follow_up: Check prevalence and probability scale alongside slope; this is a jointly estimated intercept.

rules.label: Observed / expected defaults
rules.follow_up: Inspect sampling uncertainty, event counts and cohort composition.

rules.label: Maximum feature PSI
rules.follow_up: Review feature distributions and bin counts; random holdout PSI does not establish temporal drift.

rules.label: Prediction PSI
rules.follow_up: Inspect score distributions and collect time-separated cohorts for real drift monitoring.

rules.label: Source missing-cell rate
rules.follow_up: Investigate data ingestion and schema; the historical audit does not describe a live feed.

rules.label: Maximum supported-group calibration gap
rules.follow_up: Inspect group uncertainty and denominators; neither gaps nor apparent parity certify legal fairness.

provenance: Previously inspected V1 holdout and within-cohort distribution audits, displayed retrospectively. No model selection or certification.
